# Set Decorators Society of America Awards 2025

| most_nominations =
| previous         = 2024

}}
The 6th Set Decorators Society of America Awards honored the best in set decoration in film and television of 2025.
The nominations for the film categories were announced on January 5, 2026. Set decorator Véronique Melery and production designer Mark Tildesley were the only individuals to have received multiple nominations, with two each, both for the contemporary feature film category. The winners were announced on February 21, 2026.
As per usual, the nominations for the television categories will be announced later in the year.
